title: Delhi air pollution: Police stop students’ protest march against worsening air quality near Turkman Gate

ai.summary: Students and youth marched against Delhi's worsening air quality near Turkman Gate but were stopped by police after covering 300-400 meters. Organisers claimed industrial emissions and weak enforcement of pollution controls contributed to the problem.

facts.claim: Dozens of students and young people took out a protest march against worsening air quality in central Delhi on Wednesday (November 11) evening
facts.quote: Dozens of students and young people took out a protest march against worsening air quality in central Delhi on Wednesday (November 11) evening

facts.claim: covered around 300 to 400 metres from Turkman Gate towards Jantar Mantar
facts.quote: covered around 300 to 400 metres from Turkman Gate towards Jantar Mantar

facts.claim: organised by the Revolutionary Workers’ Party of India (RWPI), Disha Students’ Organisation, Naujawan Bharat Sabha, Scientists for Society and Stree Mukti League
facts.quote: organised by the Revolutionary Workers’ Party of India (RWPI), Disha Students’ Organisation, Naujawan Bharat Sabha, Scientists for Society and Stree Mukti League

facts.claim: aimed at highlighting the impact of deteriorating air quality following Deepavali and demanding stricter enforcement of pollution-control measures
facts.quote: was aimed at highlighting the impact of deteriorating air quality following Deepavali and demanding stricter enforcement of pollution-control measures

facts.claim: We are protesting because the impact of worsening air quality on our health is evident. While political leaders sit in their offices and homes with air purifiers, pregnant women, the elderly, children and other vulnerable sections bear the brunt of it
facts.quote: We are protesting because the impact of worsening air quality on our health is evident. While political leaders sit in their offices and homes with air purifiers, pregnant women, the elderly, children and other vulnerable sections bear the brunt of it

facts.claim: Clean air is not a privilege of the rich. While industries continue to emit pollutants into the air, restrictions on other contributing factors, such as vehicular emissions and construction activities, are not effectively enforced. Construction sites are not properly covered, and despite bans under GRAP, many sites continue to operate. Vehicles within Delhi are ignored, while those entering from outside face restrictions
facts.quote: Clean air is not a privilege of the rich. While industries continue to emit pollutants into the air, restrictions on other contributing factors, such as vehicular emissions and construction activities, are not effectively enforced. Construction sites are not properly covered, and despite bans under GRAP, many sites continue to operate. Vehicles within Delhi are ignored, while those entering from outside face restrictions

facts.claim: The protesters alleged that industrial emissions and inadequate enforcement of restrictions on construction activities and vehicular pollution were contributing to the problem
facts.quote: The protesters alleged that industrial emissions and inadequate enforcement of restrictions on construction activities and vehicular pollution were contributing to the problem

facts.claim: The organisations had initially called for a march from Ramlila Maidan to Jantar Mantar. However, the protesters began marching from Turkman Gate around 4.30 p.m. before being stopped by the police
facts.quote: The organisations had initially called for a march from Ramlila Maidan to Jantar Mantar. However, the protesters began marching from Turkman Gate around 4.30 p.m. before being stopped by the police

facts.claim: Personnel from the Delhi Police and the Central Reserve Police Force surrounded the protesters on two sides and barricaded the road, preventing them from proceeding further. The protesters continued their demonstration at the spot. No one was detained
facts.quote: Personnel from the Delhi Police and the Central Reserve Police Force surrounded the protesters on two sides and barricaded the road, preventing them from proceeding further. The protesters continued their demonstration at the spot. No one was detained

facts.claim: The organisers had not sought permission for the march
facts.quote: The organisers had not sought permission for the march
